steps: eval import('/framework/ext/Playground/items.js').then(P => { const pg = window.pg; window.P = P; while (pg.doc.items.children.length) pg.doc.items.children[0].remove(); const root = pg.convert(pg.doc, P.Flex); root.set('direction','row'); root.set('gap','12px'); root.set('padding','12px'); const cols = [0,1,2].map(() => pg.add_to(root, P.Flex)); cols.forEach((c,i) => { c.set('direction','column'); c.set('gap','8px'); c.set('padding','10px'); c.set('width','fill'); c.set('bg','#eef'); c.set('label','col'+i); [0,1].forEach(j => { const b = pg.add_to(c, P.Box); b.set('height','48px'); b.set('width','fill'); b.set('bg','#ccd'); b.set('label','box'+i+j); }); }); pg.select(root.id); return document.querySelectorAll('.pg-node').length; })

eval (() => { const R = e => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return [Math.round(r.x),Math.round(r.y),Math.round(r.width),Math.round(r.height)]; }; const path = n => { const p = []; let e = n; while (e && e.classList.contains('pg-node')) { const sib = [...e.parentElement.children].filter(c => c.classList.contains('pg-node')); p.unshift(sib.indexOf(e)); e = e.parentElement.closest('.pg-node'); } return p.join('/'); }; const vis = s => [...document.querySelectorAll(s)].filter(e => e.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0).length; return { doc: [document.documentElement.scrollWidth, document.documentElement.scrollHeight], vp: R(document.querySelector('.pg-viewport')), add: vis('.pg-add'), resize: vis('.pg-resize'), nodes: [...document.querySelectorAll('.pg-node')].map(n => ({ path: path(n), r: R(n) })) }; })()
